mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market that accelerates corporate hiring and profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both above their 12-month moving averages) fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized rate above 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly GDP growth rate indicates a strong economy that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for GDPC1 as a predictor of 60-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 60-day return when GDPC1 is above its 4-quarter moving average is not significantly positive.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in industrial production above 120.0 signals strong manufacturing activity and economic momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is above 120.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 5.0% and the federal funds rate is above 3.0%, it signals a tight labor market with restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0% and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery (HOUST above 1800.0), strong housing activity drives consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above 1800.0.
